A complete implementation of the [RealWorld](https://realworld-docs.netlify.app/specifications/backend/endpoints/)

- **Runtime:** Node.js + TypeScript (run directly with `tsx`, no build step)
- **Web framework:** Fastify

- **Auth:** JWT (`Authorization: Token <jwt>`), scrypt password hashing

```bash
npm install     # installs deps and generates the Prisma client
npm run dev     # applies the schema to SQLite, then starts the server on :3000

- Profiles: view, follow, unfollow
